description: For a newly registered domain: lets Google Certificate Manager issue its HTTPS certificate (one CNAME at _acme-challenge) and points it at the website InkySites hosts (A and AAAA to the InkySites load balancer, and a www CNAME). Email records are never touched.
variableDescription: acme: the per-domain label Google Certificate Manager issues for the DNS authorization. ip4: the InkySites load balancer IPv4 address. ip6: its IPv6 address. Group 'cert' is the certificate record, 'site' the A and AAAA pair, 'www' the www CNAME, applied only at the root of a domain.
